title: Singleton coefficient of a signed tail function
statement: Let $t$ be real, let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $i$ be a coordinate in dimension $m+1$. The absolute value of the Fourier coefficient in coordinate $i$ of the signed two-sided Hamming tail function at threshold $t$ equals the signed-tail parameter defined by twice the absolute first-level Fourier coefficient of the upper-tail indicator in dimension $m+1$.
